title: Directing an AI Coding Tool
description: Learn how to specify requirements, structure prompts for reliable execution, and guide AI tools like Claude Code without typing every line — maximizing output within your energy envelope.

title: Scoping Work an AI Can Execute
description: Break a real feature into tasks sized and bounded for reliable AI execution, and manage what the model sees so it isn't guessing at your codebase's actual shape.

title: Iteration Discipline and Ownership
description: Know when to re-prompt, when to fix by hand, and when to throw an attempt away — and hold yourself accountable for AI-generated code exactly as you would for your own.
